verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a stack workflow. `cafe stack submit` opens one pull request per commit after the base, and each change can be reviewed separately. Landing merges the stack bottom-up, with Land, Restack, Unstack and Close stack actions and live progress for the latest landing and restack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-member readiness view (review/check status per stacked PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the stack workflow.
